body.text: Mobile App Development Company Kochi — that's what businesses search for when they need an iOS or Android app built properly, whether it's a consumer product, an internal team tool, or a mobile extension of an existing platform. sections.h2: Native vs Cross-Platform: Which Is Right for You?

items.title: Cross-Platform (Flutter / React Native)
items.text: Best for 85% of commercial and startup applications. One single codebase powers both iPhone and Android apps, cutting development timelines to 8–14 weeks and slashing ongoing maintenance costs in half.

items.title: Native (Swift / Kotlin)
items.text: Best for apps requiring high-frequency Bluetooth BLE sensor communication, complex audio/video rendering engines, intensive offline background sync, or platform-exclusive OS features.

sections.h2: Frequently Asked Questions — Mobile App Development Company Kochi

items.q: Should we build a native app or a cross-platform app?
items.a: It depends on your needs. Native apps offer the best performance and platform-specific feature access, making them ideal for graphics-heavy or hardware-dependent apps. Cross-platform app development Kochi using Flutter or React Native delivers near-native performance for most business and consumer apps at a significantly lower cost and faster timeline since one codebase covers both iOS and Android.

items.q: How long does mobile app development take?
items.a: Timelines vary significantly by complexity, typically ranging from 8 to 20 weeks from discovery to store launch. Simple apps with minimal backend logic can launch faster, while enterprise mobile application development with custom APIs, offline sync, and complex workflows takes longer.

items.q: Do you handle App Store and Play Store submission?
items.a: Yes. App store optimization services cover listing optimization alongside the technical submission process. We handle app review guidelines, certificates, screenshots, descriptions, and compliance checks for both Apple's App Store and Google Play.

items.q: What happens after the app launches?
items.a: App maintenance and support services cover ongoing updates, bug fixes, and compatibility maintenance as Apple and Google release new OS versions. We offer flexible post-launch support arrangements to keep your app running smoothly.

items.q: Can you build an app that connects to our existing systems?
items.a: Yes. Custom mobile app development includes integrating with existing backend systems, databases, CRMs, and third-party APIs so your mobile app works seamlessly alongside your other tools.

items.q: Do you design the app's interface, or just build the functionality?
items.a: Both. App UI UX design services are part of every project, since how an app feels and functions for the end user is as important as the code behind it. We design, test with interactive prototypes, and then build.
